purpose: Attribute residual actual-motion catastrophic faces after the best high-recall teacher-free partition to missed true mechanical boundaries inside versus outside the Stage35 unsafe scope.
stage35_scope: Unsafe mask computed teacher-free from Arachne weights and frozen Stage35 synthetic probes.
teacher_policy: Teacher topology and teacher weights are evaluation-only; partition labels and Stage35 unsafe mask are frozen first.

decision_rule.SCOPE_OWNER: Most catastrophic truth-mixed/pred-same faces are Stage35-safe.
decision_rule.PARTITION_OWNER: Most catastrophic truth-mixed/pred-same faces are already Stage35-unsafe.
